summary: fixed-wing plane: a lofted fuselage, wings and tail with separate control surfaces, landing gear and a propeller or jets; hero adds flaps, gear doors, a cabin and antennas.

overall.summary: the whole plane, 3/4 views, side and top

notes: Rename items to the real design ('Front bumper with a centre air intake'), add what the design has with keys of your own (roof rack, bull bar, side steps), split an item when a reviewer could point at its halves.
Never drop a starter item silently: delete it only with a 'waived' entry {key, why} (asset.inventory reports dropped keys; the strict check blocks them).
Tag the built geometry with scene.tag (whole objects, or faces with a select) as you build; an item counts as built only when its own geometry carries its id and touches what it attaches to.

items.name: Fuselage
items.construction: lofted from round or superellipse sections, nose to tail cone, welded

items.name: Wings
items.construction: aerofoil section swept or lofted along the span, rounded tips, root faired into the fuselage

items.name: Fin
items.construction: vertical fin lofted from aerofoil sections

items.name: Tailplane
items.construction: horizontal stabilisers

items.name: Ailerons
items.construction: cut from the wing trailing edge, hinge on the line

items.name: Elevators
items.construction: cut from the tailplane trailing edge

items.name: Rudder
items.construction: cut from the fin trailing edge

items.name: Canopy or windscreen
items.construction: glass fitted to the cockpit opening

items.name: Engine cowling or nacelles
items.construction: cowling or nacelles faired in

items.name: Propeller (static and moving)
items.construction: spinner with blades (static_prop) and a blurred disc card (moving_prop); waive for a jet

items.name: Landing gear
items.construction: gear legs with fairings carrying the wheels (gear frames)

items.name: Wheel
items.construction: lathe tyre and hub

items.name: Cockpit: seats and controls
items.construction: seats, a yoke or stick and a panel seen through the canopy

items.name: Navigation lights
items.construction: wingtip and tail lights

items.name: Doors
items.construction: cut from the fuselage (door frames)

items.name: Cabin windows
items.construction: inset windows along the fuselage

items.name: Instrument panel
items.construction: panel with gauge cards and a glare shield

items.name: Exhausts
items.construction: stubs or pipes from the cowling

items.name: Wing struts
items.construction: struts from the fuselage to the wing

items.name: Flaps
items.construction: inboard flaps cut from the trailing edge

items.name: Gear doors and wells
items.construction: wells and doors for the gear

items.name: Antennas and pitot
items.construction: blade antennas and a pitot tube

items.name: Cabin seats and floor
items.construction: seat rows and the floor

items.name: Registration and markings
items.construction: texture on own faces

views_note: views name the close-up regions of 'blender preview --regions' (data/kit/regions/plane.json) that show each region; 'overall' with no views = the standard preview sheet
